title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East on 1970-09-19
lineage: aud reel master>reel @ 3.75 ips master taped by Marty Weinberg: akg d190e>Uher 4000L reel; technics rs-1506>hd-p2 24/96 compact flash > pc > cd wave >adobe audition 2.0 > flac; transferred & seeded by Rob Berger
source: source: aud 1st gen reel; Jerry Moore's copy;

ai_review.summary: Raw yet historic recording delivers a killer Morning Dew and a standout Dark Star where Phil’s bass shines.
ai_review.review: The tape captures an unmistakably raw, historic vibe that still sounds clear enough for listening pleasure. Reviewers rave about the powerhouse performances of “Morning Dew” and a deep‑cut “Dark Star” in which Phil’s bass takes center stage, and they note the final Pigpen vocal on “Good Morning Little Schoolgirl.” The overall sound is good despite its rawness, making it a worthwhile upgrade for Deadheads.

ai_rating.rationale: All four reviewers gave 4‑5 stars and highlighted strong musical moments with only minor comments about rawness, indicating a high‑quality show on an adequately clear recording.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Described as raw and historic; some ambient background is audible but the mix remains clear enough for enjoyment.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific comments on pacing; reviewers focus on individual standout moments rather than overall set structure.

band_member_comments.Jerry: One reviewer notes that during Dark Star his guitar can sound like Phil’s bass, implying strong interplay.
band_member_comments.Phil: Praised for playing a big part in Dark Star, with his bass work highlighted as a highlight of the performance.
